title: United States FIPS Codes
text:
United States FIPS Codes
 

FIPS codes for the U.S. supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

Note:

Do not use this scheme for 
CLASIC/2
 data
 format files.

 This Area code scheme is based on the country code and the U.S. FIPS codes for states
 and counties. This scheme can only be used to identify U.S. states and counties. Click a
 state below to view the supported counties and their codes. Please note that: 

Each code begins with the three characters '01-'. This set of three characters is
 the country code for the United States. 
The leading zero is required
.

The next two digits is the state FIPS code. For example, the FIPS code of Arizona
 is '04'. 
The leading zero is required
.

The remaining three digits identify the county. The value used is the FIPS county
 code, which 
must be padded with leading zeros
 so that the county code
 occupies all three digits. For example, the FIPS code for Cochise county in
 Arizona is 3. In 
UNICEDE
/2 it should be identified by three digits, as '003'.

EXAMPLE: The complete 
UNICEDE
/2 code for Cochise county in Arizona, USA, is
 '01-04003'.
